mapper.insert: insert into kg_idempotency (idem_key, biz_type, create_time) values (#{idemKey}, #{bizType}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select biz_id from kg_idempotency where idem_key = #{idemKey}
select count(1) from kg_idempotency where idem_key = #{idemKey}
select timestampdiff(second, create_time, sysdate()) from kg_idempotency where idem_key = #{idemKey}
mapper.update: update kg_idempotency set biz_id = #{bizId} where idem_key = #{idemKey}
